title: Heap gate
statement: For natural numbers $n$, $\mathrm{base}$, $o$, and $q$, define a gate of type AND as follows. If $q\le 1$, it has no input vertices; otherwise its input vertices are $\mathrm{base}+\max(\lfloor q/2\rfloor-1,0)$ and the literal vertex with index $o+\max(\lfloor\log_2 q\rfloor-1,0)$, using $n$ to determine the literal vertex, with the Boolean label true exactly when $q$ is odd.
